description: Source code for WiFi link quality management, including reporting, event handling, and timer-based logging.

methods.name: publish_qmgr_subdoc
methods.description: Prepares and publishes link report data to the webconfig subsystem.

methods.name: ignite_score_log_timer
methods.description: Timer callback to log the current ignite link quality score and threshold.

methods.name: publish_station_score
methods.description: Publishes the station's link quality score and threshold, manages timer for periodic logging.

methods.name: link_quality_register_station
methods.description: Registers a station MAC address for link quality monitoring and callback registration.

methods.name: link_quality_unregister_station
methods.description: Unregisters a station MAC address and cancels associated timers.

methods.name: link_quality_event_exec_start
methods.description: Handles start event for link quality metrics collection.

methods.name: link_quality_event_exec_stop
methods.description: Handles stop event for link quality metrics collection.

methods.name: link_quality_hal_rapid_connect
methods.description: Handles rapid connection event, disconnects link stats.

methods.name: link_quality_ignite_reinit_param
methods.description: Reinitializes link quality parameters based on webconfig data.

methods.name: link_quality_param_reinit
methods.description: Reinitializes link quality parameters from webconfig event data.

methods.name: link_quality_hal_disconnect
methods.description: Handles disconnection event, removes link stats.

methods.name: link_quality_event_exec_timeout
methods.description: Handles timeout event, processes multiple device stats.

methods.name: exec_event_link_quality
methods.description: Dispatches link quality sub-events to appropriate handlers.

methods.name: exec_event_webconfig_event
methods.description: Handles webconfig related events, including parameter reinit.

methods.name: exec_event_hal_ind
methods.description: Handles HAL indication events for start, stop, and rapid connect.

methods.name: link_quality_event
methods.description: Main event handler for link quality related events.

methods.name: link_quality_init
methods.description: Initializes link quality application, registers data elements and opens bus.

methods.name: link_quality_deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes link quality application, cancels timers.
